"''Disengage, disengage!|A clone officer and the clone navigation officer|{{TCW|Victory and Death}}}} A [[clone trooper officer]] served as a '''clone navigation officer''' aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'' after the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. During [[Order 66]], the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] used [[the Force]] to [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|destroy]] the [[Star Destroyer]]'s [[hyperdrive]], causing it to crash on a [[Unidentified moon|moon]], [[Death|killing]] the [[clone navigation officer]] and their crew. ==Biography== ===Pre-Order 66=== This [[clone navigation officer]] served aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]''''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' during the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. During the battle, renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] was captured by the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[332nd Division]].{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}} Hence, Maul was brought to the [[Star Destroyer]] the [[Cloning|clone]] navigation [[officer]] was serving on to be transported to [[Coruscant]]. Immediately after arriving, former [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex|CT-7567]] "Rex" entered the [[Bridge (starship)|command bridge]]. The navigation officer along with other [[clone trooper officer]]s saluted the duo before entering [[hyperspace]]. ===Order 66 and death=== {{Quote|We've entered the atmosphere. Fire retrorockets!''"
"''We've lost lateral control! We're gonna break apart!|The clone navigation officer and another clone officer|}} However en route, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who had revealed himself as the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious, gave [[Order 66]], ordering all [[clone trooper]]s to turn on the [[Jedi]], including Tano. Tano managed to escaped and freed Maul to create a diversion. Maul started massacring all the clones that got in his way and eventually went to the [[engine]] room, destroying the [[hyperdrive]], sending the Star [[Destroyer]] out of hyperspace. Over [[time]], the Star Destroyer was pulled and entered the [[atmosphere]] of a [[Unidentified moon|moon]]. Another clone officer reported to the navigation officer that they had entered the atmosphere. The navigation officer ordered the bridge crew to use the [[retrorocket]]s of the Star Destroyer, but that officer told them that they had lost all lateral control of the ship as the command bridge exploded, [[Death|killing]] the officer and the bridge crew. ==Personality and traits== As a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], this clone navigation officer was a [[human]] standing 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]]) tall. They had naturally [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. ==Skills and abilities== This clone navigation officer was trained in naval warfare, excelling to the rank of Clone Commander. ==Equipment== As a clone navigation officer, the commander wore a black variant of the standard Republic military uniform with a [[Rank insignia plaque|rank insignia]] indicating their rank. ==Behind the scenes== This clone navigation officer first appeared in "[[Shattered]]", the eleventh and penultimate episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh and final season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/shattered-episode-guide|text="Shattered" Episode Guide - The Clone Wars}} which premiered on [[May 1]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/711|text=Episode 711 "Shattered"}} Like all clone troopers in ''The Clone Wars'', their voice was provided by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].{{SW|url=news/dee-bradley-baker-the-bad-batch-season-3-interview|text=Dee Bradley Baker Looks Ahead to the Final Season of ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Shattered}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Victory and Death}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone naval officers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
